title: VASP HSE relaxation from a PBE-relaxed start and HSE final-mesh static calculation
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-relax-static-hse workflow: it relaxes the geometry with PBE (unless the given structure is already PBE-relaxed), relaxes the PBE result with HSE on a coarse k-point mesh, and evaluates the HSE-relaxed structure with an HSE final-mesh static calculation, both stages through the vasp-relax-static-coarse workflow.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to relax.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the geometry of the HSE final-mesh static, and output role total_energy is a records entry containing the HSE total energy of the relaxed structure from the HSE final-mesh static calculation.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The geometry of the HSE final-mesh static: where the HSE coarse-mesh relaxation ended.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The HSE total energy of the relaxed structure from the HSE final-mesh static calculation.
